runs: Reporting non-consensual intimate content under the US Take It Down Act

>x< is committed to respecting your safety and privacy. We prohibit the publication, sharing, or distribution of non-consensual intimate photos or videos. This includes real photographs and videos as well as synthetically generated content - images or videos created or altered using artificial intelligence or other tools - that depict an identifiable individual in an intimate or sexual context without that person’s consent.

>x< maintains a clear, easy-to-use notice-and-removal process for anyone affected by such content on the >x< platform. This page provides information about our removal process and how to submit a report under the US Take It Down Act.

What happens after I submit a report?
Upon receipt of a valid removal report, we will:
Remove violative, reported intimate photos or videos as soon as possible, and no later than 48 hours after receiving the request.
